note: Ray County (MO) zones unincorporated land and Richmond/Lawson zone their cities, but no public queryable zoning district layer was found. The county GIS portal (integritygis) is unreachable from here; its assessor ArcGIS service returns 'Token Required'; the Geocortex directory is not reachable. Richmond and Lawson publish zoning maps only as eCode360 text (official map kept in the office, no download). County Planning & Zoning publishes a use table PDF, not a map. Only third-party copies (Zoneomics, Regrid, uslandgrid) exist, none official.
